1

VISUAL INSPECTION OF BATTERY

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Remove the battery cover and visually inspect the state of the battery and the terminals.

More specifically:

  • The terminals should not be oxidzed
  • The water gauge (magic eye) should not be white indicating that the electrolyte level is too low
  • The plugs or caps should not be damaged or incorrectly positioned
  • There should be no damage to the main body of the battery, the cover or the terminals
  • There should be no signs of electrolyte escaping from the battery (wet areas or large salt deposits)

Move on to Step 2

  • Terminals oxidized
  • Electrolyte level too low (the magic eye is white)
  • Problems with the plugs and/or caps
  • Damage to the body, cover and/or terminals
  • Electrolyte level too high
  • Clean the layer of oxidation from the terminals
  • Replace the batteryOp. 5530B10 BATTERY - R+R
  • Replace the batteryOp. 5530B10 BATTERY - R+R
  • Replace the batteryOp. 5530B10 BATTERY - R+R
  • Clean the area involved and top up to the correct levelOp. 5530B18 ELECTROLYTE - CHECK DENSITY AND TOP UP IF NECESSARY

2

CHECK USING MIDTRONIC EQUIPMENT

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Check that the vehicle has not been used for at least 30 minutes.

Disconnect the negative terminal and check the battery charge using the MICRO 360 equipment, tool code 1806367006, making sure that it is connected directly to the battery poles.

  • The equipment will give one of the following signals "CHARGE RETEST" or "BATT. OK+RECHARGE" or the display will remain off
  • The equipment will give one of the following signals "REPLACE BATT." or "CELL SHORT"
  • The equipment will give the signal "BATT. EFFICIENT"
  • Move on to Step 5
  • Move on to Step 6
  • Move on to Step 3

3

ELECTRICAL SYSTEM CHECK

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Check the electrical connections for the supply circuit with particular reference to the power supplies and earths

See E1010 SUPPLY

Move on to Step 4

Connections faulty

Restore the correct connections

See E1010 SUPPLY

4

ATTEMPTS AT STARTING

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Reconnect or refit the battery on the vehicle and try and start the engine several times (at least 6 or 7) with about 4-5 seconds between each attempt.

Make sure that the engine starts successfully each time

End of diagnosis

The vehicle does not start or starts with difficulty

Move on to Step 8

5

BATTERY RECHARGING

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Recharge the battery

Op. 5530B14 BATTERY - RECHARGE

using the tool 1806151001.

Move on to Step 7

6

BATTERY REPLACEMENT

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Replace the battery

Op. 5530B10 BATTERY - R+R

End of diagnosis

7

CHECK USING MIDTRONIC EQUIPMENT

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Check the battery charge using the MICRO 360 equipment, tool code 1806367006, making sure that it is connected directly to the battery poles.

  • The equipment will give one of the following signals "RETEST CHARGE." or "REPLACE BATT." or "CELL SHORT" or the display will remain off
  • The equipment will give the signal "BATT. EFFICIENT"
  • Move on to Step 6
  • Move on to Step 4
